iterations.explanation: I preserved all existing dimensions (payment integration, bike status communication, lifecycle domain events, journey state machine, location data model, and session/credential timing). The new batch introduced orthogonal axes not covered: operational metrics dashboards (7), rental orchestration via behavioral patterns like State/Command (8), usage report construction via Builder (9), biometric data handling policy (10), while verification-code TTL and inactivity logout remained within session/credential timing (6). I did not add a new payment dimension because new payment documents fit strategy-based adapters (1). Changes reflect natural separation between monitoring/metrics, construction of reports, authentication data retention, and orchestration structure.
